trade_offer.message: Patricia, I'm doing you a favor here, file it however you want. Henry's a Hall of Famer, Ward's got real starts in him, that's two actual names for one running back. Binder says yes. Sign it, send it back before Sunday - I've already moved on either way.

forum_post: Patricia's binder says most points in the league, second place, checked it twice. Binders don't tackle, sweetheart. Burrow dropped 28.88 on a bench last week and I benched Mahomes to do it. I sent your office a clean trade for Gibbs - basically charity, take it or file it, doesn't change what happens Sunday. 5-2 and I'm just getting loud.
